dateAssessment: Working campaign span: YAML January 26–29, 1730. The transcript-only assessment is compatible, not an exact match: the local long rest establishes eight hours by convention, not an outside date change. Melusa’s sleep-cycle watches below are local social estimates, independent of its stationary daylight; village activities without a clock remain open. Outside afternoon is inferred to be January 29 from t06’s four Taelgar days since entry and Episode 1’s dated January 25 entry. That four-day comparison includes earlier sessions. The current session’s exact outside start boundary remains unproved. The previous session’s closing sleep decision and this session’s opening continue the same local rest; no intervening rest is added. Waiting six hours for stars and taking a further short rest are proposals, not completed advances.
